question: How many employees and contractors did Exodus Movement say its July 2026 reduction would affect?

hits.title: Exodus Movement plans 25% workforce reduction | EXOD 8-K Filing
hits.snippet: Workforce plan affects about 77 roles, triggers $2.5–$3.5M in pre-tax charges, and is expected to deliver $10–$13M in annualized operating expense savings by 2027 if executed as planned.

hits.title: Exodus to Cut 25% of Staff in Reorg to Build Payments Platform
hits.snippet: Exodus Movement will cut 25% of its workforce as part of a reorganization to focus on building a full-stack card issuance and payments platform that supports stablecoins. The reduction was disclosed in a Friday filing.

hits.title: Exodus Movement Announced a 25% Staff Reduction
hits.snippet: Exodus did not specify how many people will be affected by the layoffs. As of the end of 2025, the company employed 215 people. Exodus Movement is not the first fintech and crypto company to report layoffs in 2026.
